_about: What each contract says about asking for uniforms (Section 10.1) and grieving (Article 12), in plain words, for the Uniform Request page. Source: contract text, quotes checked word for word (site/data/contracts/uniform-rules.json). Ben, Nov 21 2026: the form comes to Local 1776 with a copy to the employee; where the contract has no request process we file a grievance; Open Season states get a warning but the request is still taken. ARNG (PEC/TARC) is not on this form.

CA.ask: Your contract promises four sets but sets no request steps. Local 1776 files a grievance for you.
CA.time: A grievance is due within 60 days.

GU.ask: Requests go through the Agency (your unit, the CIF or G4) during FEHB Open Season each year. Outside Open Season, only for items damaged or worn out on duty.
GU.time: The Agency must order within 30 days. If items aren’t issued within 90 days of the order, it can get them another way, such as a local purchase. A grievance is due within 60 days.

IL.ask: Your unit supply orders the items. If they’re late, your supervisor gets written notice, and the Agency then has 30 days before a grievance.
IL.time: The order is due within 30 days. Late means not received within 120 days of the order, or not expected within 180 days. A grievance is due within 15 days, so tell us right away.

LA.ask: Your contract promises four sets but sets no request steps. Local 1776 files a grievance for you.
LA.time: A grievance is due within 30 days.

MI.ask: Email your unit supply, with a copy to your supervisor. We write the email for you below.
MI.time: The order is due within 15 days. If the items aren’t expected within 45 days of the order, the Agency must get them another way. Ask for a replacement within 15 days of an item wearing out. A grievance is due within 30 days.

NV.ask: Requests go through the Agency during FEHB Open Season each year. Outside Open Season, only for items damaged or worn out on duty.
NV.time: The Agency must order within 30 days. If items aren’t provided within 120 days of the order, they should be secured another way. A grievance is due within 45 days.

NM.ask: Your contract promises four sets but sets no request steps. Local 1776 files a grievance for you.
NM.time: If items aren’t provided within 120 days of the order, they should be secured another way. A grievance is due within 30 days.

SC.ask: Your contract promises four sets but sets no request steps. Local 1776 files a grievance for you. If you work outdoors regularly, you can also ask for Gore-Tex outer gear, a watch cap and cold-weather gloves (Section 11.3).
SC.time: If items aren’t provided within 120 days of the order, they should be secured another way. A grievance is due within 30 days.

SD.ask: Email your unit supply, with a copy to your supervisor. We write the email for you below.
SD.time: The order is due within 7 days. If the items aren’t expected within 45 days of the order, the Agency must get them another way. A grievance is due within 30 days.

UT.ask: Requests go through the Agency (your unit or the CIF) during FEHB Open Season each year. Outside Open Season, only for items damaged or worn out on duty.
UT.time: The Agency must order within 30 days. If items aren’t provided within 120 days of the order, they should be secured another way. A grievance is due within 30 days.
